CONFLICTING GUIDANCE
Clarify the conflicting workflow requirement
The assessed documentation establishes the points below. Your environment has not been inspected.
Current Cloud Connected compatibility differs from the feature guide
Enterprise Cloud Connected only
Current Cloud Connected compatibility blocks the general Agent Mode path: installation guidance excludes SAIA 2.2.0–
2.3.6 and says the 2.1.1 fallback lacks Agent Mode; SAIA-9918 records the access problem.
Decision impact: The feature guide still describes a 2.1+ path. Keep both scopes; planned 2.4.0 support is not a released
supported path, and meeting the minima does not resolve this block.

Version Compass · Independent public-source report
What this brief covers
Feature-specific Platform minimum, Cloud Connected app minimum, AWS AI service locations and Model Runtime requirements,
with explicit routing and data-boundary uncertainty. Current Cloud Connected installation/known-issue conflicts block a positive
Enterprise path.
Boundary: Full app/Platform compatibility, tenant activation, entitlement and regulated authorization are not established.
What the assessed documentation establishes
The Agent Mode feature guide lists Platform 10.1.x+ and a Cloud Connected SAIA 2.1+ path. These minima do not
establish current Cloud Connected compatibility.
[3] SAIA 2.3.6 Agent Mode requirements and supported regions · [5] SAIA 2.3.6 Cloud Connected setup and data assurance
The selected AWS AI service location is listed specifically for Agent Mode. Tenant activation and model/data routing
remain separate.

Missing or limited assessed evidence

guarantee is established.

What to verify or do next
1. Resolve current Cloud Connected compatibility before enabling Agent Mode
Reconcile the installation restriction and SAIA-9918 with the feature guide. A met minimum or planned 2.4.0 support
does not restore the current path. Only after an actual supported release is established, verify runtime policy and the
documented bidirectional connectivity, regional allowlist and certificate setup.

SAIA · Agent Mode
SAIA 2.3.6 documentation · GA app · feature-specific limits
Platform 10.1.x+ is required by the Agent Mode feature guide.
The feature guide describes a Cloud Connected SAIA 2.1+ path, but current installation guidance says 2.2.0–2.3.6 lacks
Cloud Connected and its 2.1.1 fallback lacks Agent Mode; SAIA-9918 independently records the access issue.
Model Runtime must be enabled; a Splunk-hosted-only setting does not satisfy the documented Agent Mode runtime choice.
Cloud Connected setup also requires the documented bidirectional connectivity, regional allowlist and certificate/stack-
address configuration.
The documented limited IL2 FedRAMP assistant excludes Agent Mode.
Cloud Connected support is planned for SAIA 2.4.0 in late November 2026; a plan does not establish a released supported
path.
Agent Mode has its own AWS-only region list; base SAIA or Azure Model Runtime availability does not establish this feature.
Cloud Connected’s broad no-third-party assurance differs from the feature-specific external-processing documentation. Preserve
both scopes; do not infer customer authorization or a residency guarantee. Current Cloud Connected compatibility is
blocked/conflicting; meeting the feature guide’s minima does not restore that path. This restriction is not transferred to native
Cloud deployments.
Capability record assessed 2026-11-03. Later section-specific assessments below do not advance every prerequisite date.
Self-reported context only. This brief does not establish complete compatibility, entitlement, tenant availability, health, compliance or customer
authorization.
